simple.meaning: to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication ( of reticulation ) to inchase gems in gold
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to שָׁבַץ (H7660) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

definitions.short: to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication ( of reticulation ) to inchase gems in gold
definitions.full: H7660. shabats [ שָׁבַץ ] verb Pi`el probably weave in chequer or plaited work (Late Hebrew שָׁבַץ ornament a vessel with a pattern ; Syriac (Lexicons) immiscuit , commixtio: see also Lag BN 143 ); — Pi`el Perfect 2masculine singular וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֫ Exod 28:39 (P), and thou shalt chequer (or plait) the tunic (in) byssus. Pu`al Participle masculine plural זָהָב מְשֻׁבָּצִים Exod 28:20 (P), inwoven (i.e. set in a chequered or plaited mounting) with gold (-thread) shall they be (of gems).
